objects.name: Continent
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Continent" (
	"ContinentId"	INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	"ContinentName"	varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	PRIMARY KEY("ContinentId" AUTOINCREMENT)
)

objects.name: FoodType
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "FoodType" (
	"FoodId"	INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	"Food"	varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	PRIMARY KEY("FoodId" AUTOINCREMENT)
)

objects.name: Insect
objects.ddl: CREATE TABLE Insect (KingdomId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Kingdom (KingdomId), InsectId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL UNIQUE, Name varchar (100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, ContinentId INTEGER REFERENCES Continent (ContinentId) NOT NULL, TypeId INTEGER REFERENCES Type (TypeId) NOT NULL, FoodId INTEGER REFERENCES FoodType (FoodId) NOT NULL, Sound varchar (100) UNIQUE, Photo varchar (100) UNIQUE)

objects.name: Kingdom
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Kingdom" (
	"KingdomId"	INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	"KingdomName"	varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	PRIMARY KEY("KingdomId" AUTOINCREMENT)
)

objects.name: Reptile
objects.ddl: CREATE TABLE Reptile (KingdomId INTEGER NOT NULL, ReptileId INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, Name varchar (100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, ContinentId INTEGER NOT NULL, TypeId INTEGER REFERENCES Type (TypeId) NOT NULL, FoodId INTEGER NOT NULL, Sound varchar (100) UNIQUE, Photo varchar (100) UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY (ReptileId AUTOINCREMENT), FOREIGN KEY (ContinentId) REFERENCES Continent (ContinentId), FOREIGN KEY (FoodId) REFERENCES FoodType (FoodId), FOREIGN KEY (KingdomId) REFERENCES Kingdom (KingdomId))

objects.name: Type
objects.ddl: CREATE TABLE Type (TypeId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT UNIQUE NOT NULL, TypeName varchar (100) UNIQUE NOT NULL)
